texts.preamble: Niyas T K vs Kottayam Municipality on 30 June, 2025 Author: C.S.Dias Bench: C.S.Dias 2025:Ker:47419 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr.Justice C.S.Dias Monday, The 30Th Day Of June 2025 / 9Th Ashadha, 1947 Wp(C) No. 23834 Of 2025 Petitioner: Niyas T K Aged 49 Years S/O T K Kunhumuhammed, Thazhchayil, Thazhathangady P O, Kottayam District, Pin - 686005 By Adv Sri.K.Rajesh Kannan Respondent: Kottayam Municipality Municipal Office Building, Ymca Road, Kottayam, Kerala, Represented By Its Secretary, Pin - 686001 By Adv Sri.Ajit Joy This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On 30.06.2025, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: Wp(C) No. 23834 Of 2025 2 2025:Ker:47419 Judgment
texts.facts: 2. The petitioner is the owner of a fish stall and supermarket functioning in a premises situated within the territorial limits of the 1st respondent - Municipality. Ext.P3 licence has been issued in favour of the petitioner. Alleging that the petitioner has carried out unauthorised construction, the respondent has issued Ext.P8 stop memo directing the petitioner to stop the construction of an existing building. Even though the petitioner has submitted Ext.P9 representation before the respondent on 25.06.2025, the same has not been considered. The petitioner's apprehends that the respondent may take coercive proceedings pursuant to Ext.P8 stop memo, without considering Ext.P9 representation.
